title: Solr answers its admin API without signing in
summary: The Solr admin API reports its cores to a caller with no credentials, so the same caller can query, change or drop the indexes.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("\"responseHeader\"") and body_contains("\"status\"") and not body_contains("<html") and body_differs(control)

reproduce: curl -sk "https://host/solr/admin/cores?action=STATUS&wt=json" and look for "responseHeader" and a "status" listing cores.
remediate: Put the interface behind authentication and off the public internet.
